title: Suv qattiqligi va uni yumshatish modeli
goal: Vaqtinchalik va doimiy qattiqlikni manba ionlari hamda mos yumshatish usuli bilan bog‘lang.
authoringReason: Legacy 9.2 practice does not primarily teach water hardness.

title: Mis, kumush va oltin: xossa–qo‘llanish taqqoslash modeli
goal: Cu, Ag va Au ning nisbiy faolligi, fizik xossalari va qo‘llanishini taqqoslang.
authoringReason: Generic metals problem set is not an adequate primary activity for Cu/Ag/Au.

title: II guruh yonaki guruhcha elementlari trend modeli
goal: Zn, Cd va Hg uchun guruh bo‘yicha xossa va birikmalar trendini taqqoslang.
authoringReason: Zn(OH)2 experiment covers zinc only; group-level trend needs a model.

title: Cho‘yan va po‘lat ishlab chiqarish texnologik case’i
goal: Xomashyo, qaytarilish, uglerod miqdori va mahsulot xossalari asosida ishlab chiqarish zanjirini tahlil qiling.
authoringReason: Sample observation does not cover the production process.

title: Bir atomli spirtlar: tuzilish–xossa modeli
goal: Bir atomli spirtlarning funksional guruhi, eruvchanligi va tipik xossalarini molekula tuzilishi bilan bog‘lang.
authoringReason: Legacy glycerin/formalin experiment is not a primary interaction for monohydric alcohols.

title: Fenol va aromatik spirtlarni taqqoslash modeli
goal: Fenol va aromatik spirtlarda OH guruhining bog‘lanish joyi hamda xossalardagi farqni taqqoslang.
authoringReason: Legacy acid/glycerin/glucose identification activity does not teach phenols.

title: Aldegid va ketonlarni farqlash modeli
goal: Karbonil guruhining joylashuvi va sifat belgilariga ko‘ra aldegid hamda ketonlarni farqlang.
authoringReason: Legacy practice covers formalin but not ketones, so the old full mapping is too broad.

title: Karbon kislotalarning xossalari — virtual tajriba
goal: Sirka kislotasining indikator va karbonat bilan reaksiyalarini virtual tajribada kuzating va xulosa qiling.
authoringReason: Dedicated acid-properties scenario replaces a generic identification activity as primary.

title: Murakkab efirlar: hosil bo‘lish va tuzilish modeli
goal: Kislota va spirt qismlaridan murakkab efir hosil bo‘lishini hamda funksional guruhini modelda bog‘lang.
authoringReason: Steam distillation of plant oils does not establish ester chemistry as the primary interaction.

title: Tabiiy va sun’iy tolalarni tasniflash trenajyori
goal: Tola namunalari va tavsiflarini tabiiy, sun’iy va sintetik guruhlarga tasniflang.
authoringReason: Paper recycling is not a primary activity for fiber classification.

title: Organik tuzilish nazariyasi molekula modeli
goal: Uglerod skeleti va molekulyar formula orasidagi bog‘lanishni modelda tekshiring.
authoringReason: Shared legacy 10.4 model cannot carry a unit-specific structure-theory config without colliding with isomerism/homologous-series units.

title: Izomeriya: bir formula — turli tuzilish modeli
goal: Bir xil molekulyar formulaga ega turli tuzilishlarni aniqlang.
authoringReason: Dedicated canonical identity prevents shared 10.4 practice config collision.

title: Alkanlar gomologik qatori modeli
goal: Uglerod atomlari soniga ko‘ra alkan gomologining formulasini aniqlang.
authoringReason: Dedicated canonical identity prevents shared 10.4 practice config collision.
